captions.text: Why is it always stuck at !99%?!
captions.say: Why is it always stuck at ninety-nine percent?

captions.text: They count *steps:* files copied, chunks downloaded, tasks finished.
then one huge file or a final check !takes forever,!
The program can't know in advance
how long each step will take,
so the bar is really a !guess.!
Some apps even *ease the bar forward* to look smooth.
